tail:
Batch 4 of `frontier-23` is fully authored. Summary of what landed:

**Authored artifacts** (all `status: draft`)
- All 47 planned item files under `items/` (30 on the A page, 17 on the B page), ids unchanged from the scaffold.
- Both pages: [characters-and-the-orthogonality-relations.md](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/abstract-algebra/characters-and-the-orthogonality-relations.md) and [characters-and-the-orthogonality-relations-examples.md](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/abstract-algebra/characters-and-the-orthogonality-relations-examples.md).
- [frontier-23-batch-4.proof-contracts.json](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-23-batch-4.proof-contracts.json): version 1, scope = the 37 proof-bearing items, each with citations, step derivations, and all eight boundary dispositions.
- Appended `## Step-5 authoring` to [frontier-23-batch-4.notes.md](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-23-batch-4.notes.md) with authored ids, provenance rationale, corrections, and check results.

**Recovery work on the checkpoint files.** The interrupted run had committed all 47 files with hard-wrapped proof steps, failing precheck (`untagged-steps` on 37 files). I reflowed them with `tools/reflow.mts`, then adopted the checker's canonical phase stratification (relabelling and reordering step lines via its own `layerRepair`, iterated to a fix point). Final precheck: **37 checked, 0 failing**.

**Mathematical fixes made while verifying.** One missing dependency (additivity of characters was used but undeclared in the sum-of-squares corollary), three declared-but-uncited facts removed rather than fabricated into citations (trace linearity in the averaging lemma; the character-table definition in column orthogonality; the normality definition in the quotient proposition), two phantom step references corrected, three missing fact citations added, and one multiline display joined to satisfy the render contract. No planned claim was narrowed or dropped.

**Checks run, all on batch scope:**
- `precheck` — 37/37 clean; `validate-plan` — OK; item-scoped `content-policy` — 47 items, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `proof-contract --strict` — 0 errors, 37/37; `boundary-audit --fail-on-contradicted --fail-on-template` — clean; `citation-fidelity` — 126 citations, every quote present; `risk-report` — 37 routed.
- `finite-smoke` — 0 checks over 0/37 items, recorded honestly: no registered check models a character-table/orthogonality claim, and I did not attach an unrelated one.
- `rendercheck`, `depcheck`, `fwdcheck`, `extcheck`, `depsource`, `pathcheck` — no batch-4 findings.

**Caveats recorded in the notes, not mine to fix:** the remaining repo-level failures are all foreign-batch (smooth-manifolds batch 9 wikilinks/displays/forward refs, and a batch-6 manifest drift in `splice-verify`); the shell DNS liveness probe from scaffolding remains a runner-local transport issue with all three coverage URLs already re-opened and fetch-verified. The item-file dependency deltas versus the scaffold manifest (one dep added, two removed) are documented in the notes rather than applied to the manifest, so the planning record stays untouched for the drift/impact machinery.
